text: Ñalnde yedduɓe Allah e Nulaaɗo mun on weeɓitoytee e Yiite ngen fii lepteede, ɓe feliree wwi'eede: wanaa goonga reenuɗon e ɗee lepte? Kaa on fenniray wano fenniraynoɗon aduna non? Ɓe wi'a: Ko non tigiri woniri, men woondirii Joomi amen. Ɓe wi'anee: awa meeɗiree lepte ɗen, sabu ko yeddirɗon kon Allah.
